## Current progress report — November 15, 2026

The **[progress report](../progress.qmd)** documents CAD and printed assembly, received components, Hall-sensor and ADC testing, 16-bit MCU–FPGA SPI development, MOSFET/PWM testing, and design-review preparation. It includes the updated schematics and block diagrams.
